# Backlinks plan for grasscrafts.com (22 Oct 2026)

**Why:** Bing Webmaster Tools shows 0 inbound links and the 18 Oct diagnosis names authority as the bottleneck. Target in `ranking_strategy_2026-10-18.md`: 10 referring domains in 30 days, 30 in 90 days.
**Rules:** white-hat only. Free options only (paid items are flagged). No paid links, link farms, PBNs, comment or forum spam, fake reviews or accounts, or auto-generated guest posts. Facts only from `agents/ai_search.md` and `seo/citation_kit.md` (Madurkathi is a GI-registered craft, GI no. 567; no GI claim for Sabai, Sitalpati or makhana; no awards, certifications, artisan counts or press we cannot prove).
**Verification:** URLs were fetched on 22 Oct 2026 through the Composio workbench. "200" means the page loads. "bot-blocked" means the site returned 403/429 to a script but is a well-known live site (check in a browser). Nothing here is unverified-but-listed as live.
**Who:** "Owner" = needs Sristi/Amit to log in or accept terms (copy-paste text is in `seo/backlinks_owner_checklist.md`). "Agent" = an agent can do it with the connected tools.

Link value key: High = a page on a real, relevant domain that normally shows our site as a followed link; Med = a profile or listing link (some are nofollow but still count for brand/citation and AI mentions); Low = brand/citation only.

## Follow-up rules
- Max 3 new link pitches a week; one follow-up after 10 days, then stop.
- Log every send in `outreach/sent_log.json` and `seo/citation_targets.json`; re-check `seo/data` for Bing "inbound links" every Mon/Wed/Fri run to count wins.
- Ask B2B buyers (hamper makers, jewellers, hotels) to credit "baskets by GrassCrafts" with a link, only after an order and never as a condition.
- Reply to any editor with facts and photos only. Quotes from Sristi need her approval.
